detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Methylene Blue (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Methylene Blue
  • Chemical Class: Phenothiazine dye (small-molecule compound)
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₆H₁₈ClN₃S
  • Molecular Weight: ~319.85 g/mol
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Methylene Blue is a synthetic small-molecule compound belonging to the phenothiazine chemical class. It has a long history of use as a chemical dye and redox indicator in laboratory and analytical research environments.

This product is supplied in an encapsulated solid format to support controlled storage, handling, and analytical preparation within laboratory research settings. The encapsulated format serves solely as a physical containment and presentation method and does not imply any route of administration or intended method of use.

Methylene Blue is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals working with small-molecule compounds.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro use as a redox indicator in biochemical and chemical assay systems
  • Analytical method development involving phenothiazine dyes
  • Laboratory studies of small-molecule redox behavior under controlled conditions
  • Comparative evaluation of synthetic dyes and redox-active compounds in research models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research compound
  • Appearance: Blue crystalline solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in appropriate laboratory solvents following removal from the encapsulation format for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

Methylene Blue is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
